Zing is always about something sharp, bright, and briefly intense. Whether it's a sound, a feeling, a flavor, or a remark — a "zing" hits you suddenly, has a crisp edge to it, and leaves a little impression. It's the opposite of dull, flat, or slow.
Zing captures the idea of something sharp, fast, and hitting exactly where it's aimed — whether that's a physical object cutting through the air, or a clever remark cutting through a conversation.

A zinger is a short, sharp, and clever remark that hits hard. Think of it as a verbal punch — one that is delivered quickly, lands powerfully, and is difficult to forget or recover from. The word is informal and used mostly in everyday speech and writing.

"Zingy" describes something that has a sharp, lively, and pleasantly stimulating quality — a kind of bright energy that hits you quickly and makes you sit up and notice. It's the feeling of something waking you up a little, in a good way.
To fasten something with a zip, as in "zip your coat." It also means to move very fast, as in "cars zipped past," or to compress a computer file to make it smaller.

"Zippy" means pleasantly fast, lively, and full of energy. When you call something zippy, you're saying it moves, works, or feels quick and spirited — and that this quality is a good thing. The word always carries a positive, cheerful feeling.
Zircon is a naturally occurring mineral — meaning it forms on its own in the Earth through geological processes, without any human involvement.

Zirconium is a chemical element — one of the roughly 118 fundamental building blocks that make up all matter in the universe. It has the chemical symbol Zr and the atomic number 40, meaning every atom of zirconium has exactly 40 protons in its nucleus.
A zither is a musical instrument — one that you play by plucking or strumming strings stretched across a flat, shallow wooden box.

The zodiac is an imaginary circular belt, or band, of sky that wraps all the way around the Earth. Think of it like a wide ribbon stretched across the entire night sky, forming a complete ring around our planet.

Zodiacal simply means "of, relating to, or belonging to the zodiac." Anything that is connected to the zodiac — its band in the sky, its constellations, its signs, its light — can be described as zodiacal.
A zoetrope is a physical device — shaped like a hollow drum or cylinder — that creates the illusion of a moving image from a series of still pictures.
A zombie is a dead person who has somehow come back to "life" — but not fully. A zombie is not alive in the normal sense. It has no thoughts, no feelings, no personality, and no free will.

To zombify something or someone means to turn them into a zombie, or to make them act like one. The word is built directly on "zombie," so understanding what a zombie is helps you understand what zombifying means.
Of, relating to, characterized by, or organized according to zones.
In a way that relates to zones, especially in a direction running east–west, parallel to the lines of latitude, as in "winds blowing zonally."

Zonation is the process or result of something being divided into distinct zones (bands or layers), arranged in a recognizable pattern, where each zone has its own unique set of characteristics or inhabitants.

A zone is a defined area or region that is set apart from everything around it because something specific is true about it — a rule that applies there, a purpose it serves, a natural condition that exists there, or a quality that makes it different from neighboring areas.
To zone out means to stop paying attention to what is happening around you, even though your eyes are open and your body is still present.
The system by which a local government divides land into areas, or zones, and sets rules about what can be built and what activities are allowed in each.

To zonk means to hit something or someone hard and suddenly — or to put someone into a state of deep unconsciousness or complete exhaustion, either through a blow, a drug, alcohol, or sheer tiredness. The word carries a sense of suddenness and completeness.

"Zonk out" means to fall asleep suddenly and deeply, usually because you are very tired or exhausted. When someone zonks out, they don't drift off slowly — they go from being awake to being fast asleep very quickly, sometimes without even planning to.
Extremely tired or exhausted (informal). It can also mean heavily under the influence of drugs or alcohol.
Zoolatry is the worship of animals as divine beings.
Zoological simply means "relating to animals" or "relating to the scientific study of animals."
To zoom means to move or go very fast, often with a smooth, swift quality. When something zooms, it doesn't just move quickly — it moves impressively quickly, with energy.
Something is zoomorphic when it is shaped like, designed to look like, or given the form of an animal.
Zoomorphism is the practice of assigning animal qualities, traits, forms, or behaviors to something that is not an animal — most commonly to humans, gods, or abstract ideas.
A zoophyte is an animal that looks so much like a plant that early scientists genuinely struggled to decide which one it was.

Zooplankton are tiny animals (and animal-like organisms) that live in water and drift with currents rather than swimming on their own. They are one of the most important groups of living things on Earth.

Zugzwang describes a situation where you are forced to act, but every single action available to you will make your situation worse than it already is. If only you could do nothing — just stay still and let the moment pass — you'd be better off.
A zwitterion is a single molecule that carries both a positive charge and a negative charge at the same time — on different parts of the molecule — but whose overall (net) charge adds up to zero.
Zydeco is a style of music — a genre — that comes from the American state of Louisiana, specifically from its southwestern region.
Zymology is the branch of science that studies fermentation — what it is, how it works, and how to control or use it.

Zymotic means "relating to fermentation" — the biological process where microorganisms like yeast or bacteria break down a substance (such as sugar) and transform it into something else (like alcohol, acid, or gas).
Zymurgy is the branch of science — specifically applied chemistry — that studies and manages the process of fermentation, particularly for making alcoholic drinks like beer, wine, and spirits.

When you call something à la mode, you are saying it is fashionable, trendy, or in style right now. It means something is currently popular and considered the height of good taste by people who follow trends and fashion.

Éclat means a kind of dazzling, brilliant success — the sort that turns heads, commands admiration, and makes an impression that lingers. It is not just success; it is success performed with such flair, style, and force that it becomes almost a spectacle.
Élan means doing something with a combination of energy, enthusiasm, and effortless style — all at the same time, fused together.
A person who has great power and influence behind the scenes without holding an official position — originally said of Father Joseph, Cardinal Richelieu's grey-robed adviser.

An étude is a piece of music — almost always for a solo instrument, most commonly the piano — built around practicing one specific technical skill. Think of it as a musical exercise disguised as a real piece of music.
